propositions: The test exhausts all 232 eligible prose units despite only requiring existential proof that at least one is eligible and at least one changes, causing 8.829s runtime overhead from 231 unnecessary Pandoc subprocess calls.

Test iteration must stop immediately once both existential witnesses (eligible unit exists, changed unit exists) are observed while retaining failure semantics when no eligible units or no changed units exist.
Exact short-circuit evaluation reduces paired runtime from 8.865s/232 calls to 0.036s/1 call without altering _render_unit, product behavior, or independent full-corpus coverage tests.
Negative controls (identity renderer, no-eligible source) remain discriminating under the short-circuit fix and continue to fail appropriately.
